# Smashed Burgers & Co.

> Smash burger restaurant in Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala, India. Beef patties are smashed to order on a flat-top griddle. Fries are cooked in beef tallow. Open every day from 6 PM to 4 AM. Delivery through Zomato.

## Facts

- Name: Smashed Burgers & Co. (also written Smashed Burgers Co.)
- Address: 64/5257 G, Kathrikadavu, Kaloor Kadavanthra Road, Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala, India
- Hours: every day, 6 PM to 4 AM
- Delivery: Zomato, listed as "Smashed Burgers & Co, Kaloor"
- Average cost: about ₹500 for two people, per Zomato
- Instagram: @smashedburgersandco
- Tagline: "Obsession doesn't take days off"

## Menu

- Animal Smash: two smashed beef patties, signature animal sauce, double melted cheese, crisp lettuce. A take on the California double animal style.
- OG Smash Classic: one smashed beef patty, cheddar, house sauce. Also comes as a Double.
- Jammin' Bacon: smashed beef with smoky beef bacon.
- The Alchemy: smashed beef, melted cheese, caramelised onions, signature sauce.
- Smashed Beef Mushroom, Tokyo: smashed beef, melted cheese, grilled mushrooms, house special sauce.
- Nashville Fried Chicken Burger: crispy fried chicken, Nashville hot spice, pickles, house sauce.
- Tallow Fries: fat-cut fries cooked in beef tallow. Also available loaded with cheese sauce and smashed beef.
- Value meals pair burgers with tallow fries.
